repos_data.description: Think before doing, prove before saving. Vestige is the local-first cognitive operating system and deterministic safety kernel for autonomous AI agents. Powered by FSRS-6 causal graph memory, cryptographic Merkle-chained state ledgers, and out-of-band kernel gates bringing frontier PhD reasoning to local silicon with zero cloud token tax.
Superpowers your agent's debugging: what introduced this bug, and is my fix actually complete? Deterministic, offline, read-only, MCP-native.
What changed, and where did it start? A read-only MCP server and CLI that ranks changes across metrics, logs and traces and tells causes from echoes.
